purpose: Measure implicit activation against the SKILL.md description alone, with no explicit $fufu-neko mention and no /skills selection, in both positive and negative directions.
note: Run each case in a fresh session with allow_implicit_invocation left at its default (true). Do not type $fufu-neko or open /skills. Record the raw decision for every case, including the negative ones, so trigger precision and recall can be compared as a pair.

cases.prompt: 帮我评审一下这个 Agent 架构，看看分层是否合理。
must: Activates without an explicit skill mention because the task matches the description.
Inspects the repository and the actual agent layout before giving a review.
Names the layering or boundary it considers weak and gives a recommended direction.
must_not: Requires the user to mention the skill explicitly before starting.
Answers from generic architecture advice without reading the project.

cases.prompt: 我们在选一个队列方案，结合当前项目生态给个建议。
must: Activates implicitly and treats the recommendation as time-sensitive.
Separates current verified facts from the recommendation.
must_not: Declines the task as out of scope for an unnamed skill.

cases.prompt: 帮我把这段文案里的错别字改掉。
must: Edits the supplied text directly and returns the corrected version.
must_not: Inspects a repository or researches external sources.
Opens a decision gate or asks for a project fact.

cases.prompt: 把这句中文翻译成日语：请稍等一下。
must_not: Loads a repo-first workflow or adds a recommendation section.

cases.prompt: 把这段 JSON 重新缩进成两空格。
must: Reformats the JSON without altering any value.
must_not: Starts a review, asks a structured question, or performs web research.
